data.comment:
# Comfy HeyGen- Text to Speech

Generate natural-sounding speech from text using HeyGen's advanced TTS engine, supporting a wide range of languages and accents with customizable voices. Input your text and select from numerous preset voices or clone a custom voice from a short audio sample. Ideal for creating voiceovers for videos, generating multilingual narration, and producing personalized audio content. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_heygen_text_to_speech.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.text: Input text here and choose a voice to speech it out.
